_about: The voiced lines, in the order the game says them: each key's English is read from locales/locales.json. Every line is recorded by a real person (no AI or device voice: the user, 2026-11-20). 'when' is the moment in the game a line is said and 'mood' how it should feel: both are notes to the reader in docs/VO_RECORD.txt (python3 tools/vo_split.py --script). 'spoken' holds what the reader says only when it must differ from the words on screen (tools/vo_split.py already reads x as 'ex' and −5 as 'minus five'). Clips: assets/VO/en/<key>.webm, cut by tools/vo_split.py.

when.voWelcome: the player has just tapped Play
when.tutDragOp: first game: a hand shows the -5 ball going into the cannon
when.tutTapFireOne: first game: the ball is in, now the Fire button
when.voFreed1: the shot worked: x jumps out of the cage
when.voFreed2: the shot worked: x jumps out of the cage
when.voFreed3: the shot worked: x jumps out of the cage
when.voFreed4: the shot worked: x jumps out of the cage
when.voStuck1: the shot missed: x is still in the cage
when.voStuck2: the shot missed: x is still in the cage
when.voEndAll: the end: the player freed x every time
when.voEndMost: the end: the player freed x most times
when.voEndSome: the end: the player freed x only a few times
